request.style: English, female mezzo-soprano solo with gentle choir, upright bass, brushed drums, piano, saxophone, mellow mood, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
House of David, listen now
Patience worn thin by the crowd
Do not weary your God again
Ask for a sign, deep or high
Ahaz refuses the test
Will not put the Lord to trial
Then the prophet speaks aloud
The Lord himself will give you proof

[Chorus]
See, the virgin will conceive
Give birth to a son, she says
And she will call him Immanuel
The sign is given, clear and true
God is with us, the name reveals
A promise standing in the street
The virgin will conceive
She will give birth to a son
And she will call him Immanuel

[Verse]
He will eat curds and honey
When he knows enough to choose
Reject the wrong, select the right
Before he walks in full understanding
The land of the two kings you dread
Will be laid waste, broken down
Days like none since Ephraim left
The king of Assyria shall come

[Chorus]
See, the virgin will conceive
Give birth to a son, she says
And she will call him Immanuel
The sign is given, clear and true
God is with us, the name reveals
A promise standing in the street
The virgin will conceive
She will give birth to a son
And she will call him Immanuel

[Outro]
Immanuel, God with us
The sign remains, the promise stands
